comment: Windows backslash in-project -> keep (separator normalization; without _norm the root+'/' prefix check missed backslash paths)
UNC share in-project -> keep (backslashes normalized to forward slashes, isAbsolutePath accepts //server/...)
trailing separator on cwd -> keep (trailing sep stripped by _norm)
trailing backslash on cwd -> keep (trailing sep stripped after backslash normalization)
mixed separators in-project -> keep (backslash normalized to forward slash before prefix check)

case mismatch in-project: on case-insensitive FS (Darwin/Win32) the paths are the SAME dir -> keep; on case-sensitive FS (Linux) they differ -> drop. expected_drop is the case-sensitive result; expected_drop_casefold is the case-insensitive result.
relative path -> never drop (not attributable to a specific project; falls through to the token-overlap rule)
cwd absent -> never drop (legacy callers stay unfiltered)
